---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or a new capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the situation rather than only
the solution — the design docs in `specs/` may already constrain the approach.

## Proposed behavior

What you would like Watcher to do.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why you prefer this proposal.

## Scope

- Does this touch a `Source`, `Detector`, `Backend`, or `Sink`? (See the
  interface boundaries in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).)
- Does it add or change a requirement? If so, which milestone's spec does it
  belong to?
